title: Refute HOLD: USPTO ODP four-field profile gate still mandatory
claim: Live USPTO ODP Support FAQ (fetched 2026-09-13) still states that effective August 18, 2026 users must provide four profile fields—Job Title, Organization Name, Organization Type, and Intended Use—or lose access to ODP products and API keys. Sign-in with USPTO.gov + MFA remains required (since June 18, 2026). Standing claim HOLD: four-field gate unchanged; not lifted.
excerpt: When prompted to complete your profile, you will be asked to provide the following four fields: Job Title; Organization Name; Organization Type; Intended Use. As of August 18, 2026, completing these fields will be required to continue accessing ODP data products.
